## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `ad6e39cc0e753296a8570463b02f14ada299434a`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: cards #35883 and #35884 (bodies and every comment, including the 06:07Z and 06:08Z claims and the 04:16Z coordinator note), the PR body and file list (37 files), the net diff against its merge base with `main` (`c00be39b7`), and the check-runs on the head. Every check-run concluded `success` or `skipped` (no failure, nothing pending): Type Check UI, Lint UI, Test UI 1 to 16, Build and E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check PR Size. No published schema or governed path is in the tree, so the declaration face applies and there is no section ④.

### ① Derived judgments

Every change to the public surface the diff makes, each judged:

- `@object-ui/components`: `SortBuilder` gains `layout?: 'rows' | 'stacked'` (default `rows`), `onAddLevel` and `onChangeLevelField`. All three are optional, the default render is the same, and the move/update/remove writes are shared by both layouts. **Right.** Touch reorder (pointer events, `touch-none`, `data-vaul-no-drag`) now also applies to the `rows` layout on touch devices. That widens behaviour and removes nothing. **Right.** Two new safe-translation defaults are added (`sortBuilder.levelOptions`, `.changeField`). **Right.**
- `@object-ui/plugin-list` index: new exports `PhonePanelSheet`, `useListPhonePanels`, `PHONE_CHIP`, `PHONE_CHIP_ACTIVE` and the types `PhonePanelSheetProps`, `ListPhonePanels`. These are additive, and app-shell's title switcher consumes them. **Right.**
- `@object-ui/plugin-list` `FilterPanel.advancedOffered`: the prop is optional and defaults to `true`, so desktop behaviour is unchanged. **Right as code, wrong as a declaration.** `FilterPanel` is not exported from the package index, and the package's only entry is `.`. The changeset's line "`FilterPanel` takes `advancedOffered`" names a surface no consumer can reach (see should-fix S1). Likewise `NamedCondition`, `useLookupValueNames`, `ListPhonePanelsContext` and app-shell's `FOOTER_ITEM` become module-level exports only. They are not package surface, which is **right**.
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid` index: new exports `requestListSelection` and `useListPageSelecting`. `useListSelectionRequest` and `usePublishListSelecting` stay internal. **Right.** `BulkActionBar` gains `open?: boolean` (default `false`). The `count === 0` early return and the Escape listener now also honour `open`, the actions are not drawn at 0, and no existing host changes behaviour. **Right.**
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid` card renderer: a card becomes `role="button"`, `tabIndex={0}` and `aria-pressed` while selecting. Long press selects, a tap toggles while selecting, Enter and Space work on the card's own key, and the card scroller now carries the grid root ref. This repairs the census row the PR deletes (deletions-only backlog rule), and `cardSelection-35883` pins it. **Right.** See nit N3 on the inert-card case.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list` `ListView` below `sm` (`useBelowSm`): the desktop toolbar row and condition row are no longer drawn. They are replaced by the pill row, which takes the host's `toolbarLeading`, `toolbarTrailing` and `conditionRowEnd`. The host's `toolbarTrailing` is now called with the phone search alone, and the 视图设置 props are reused through `viewSettingsElement.props`. Sort ✓ goes through `applySort`, so it ends in `onSortChange`. Filter ✓ goes through `applyPanelFilters`, so it ends in `onFilterChange`. These are the desktop's one write, so there is no second save path, which is what the parent epic's "one content, new container" ruling asks for. **Right.** See N1 and N2.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: new keys in all 11 packs: `listConditions.phone.*`, `sortBuilder.levelOptions` / `.changeField` and `console.objectView.select`. The count families carry each pack's CLDR slots plus a base key (ar has zero to other, en has one and other). This is additive. **Right.**
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: `PhonePageBar` (store, provider, publish hook), `ObjectViewMoreMenu` (extracted, with `leading` and `triggerClassName`), and `ObjectViewSwitcherMenu`'s `phone` / `footerEnd` are all internal. The package index exports none of them, which matches the changeset's "changes no public export". **Right.** The 「Select」 item is the one part that is **wrong in its gating** (see should-fix S2).

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/35883-phone-list-toolbar-panels.md` bumps `patch` on `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`. These are exactly the five released packages the diff moves. None is missed and none is extra.
- AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist step 3) sets the level by kind alone. `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening also ships `patch`. The diff adds no spec key, accepted value or metadata type, so `none` is correct and `patch` is the right level. **Matches.**
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body, with a well-formed arm. The diff only adds optional props and exports; it removes, renames or tightens nothing on any published declaration. **Widening is correct.** One caveat: the changeset's public-surface list over-declares `FilterPanel.advancedOffered` (S1).

### ③ Boundary flags

The PR body has no `open_questions` section. Each dev flag and claim seat call, answered or escalated:

- **Seat call (1), and follow-up: Save belongs to #35955.** Answered in the code: `conditionRowEnd` is drawn at the end of the pill row, and until #35955 lands it shows today's 「Personalized · Reset」. **Escalated (S3).** The PR says `Fixes #35883`. #35883's acceptance rows for 「保存」 (it appears after sort or filter, 「放弃改动」, 「另存为我的视图」 with the default name, 「已保存」) and the 04:16Z note (view-settings edits are temporary and raise Save) cannot be met by this PR alone. #35884's "刷新后回到视图原来的顺序，「保存」消失" has the same problem. Nothing on either card records #35955 taking those rows. Merging as written closes #35883 with them unmet.
- **Seat call (2): the selection bar belongs to #35678.** #36021 landed first, and the cards use its floating `BulkActionBar` with the new `open`. **Answered, right.**
- **Follow-up: a link cell's click wins over ticking while selecting.** This holds under the objectstack#33548 cell rule and is offered as a separate card. **Answered:** a fair deferral that breaks no acceptance row, because the card body's tick rows name taps on the card.
- **Claim `Clause-②: no (provisional … amended if it reads yes)`.** The PR and changeset now read `yes (widening)`, but neither claim on #35883 or #35884 was amended. **Nit N5.**
- **#35884 acceptance "屏幕键盘弹出时，「✓」和正在输入的框都不被挡住".** The claim's scope promises it, but no test and no line in the PR's browser verification evidences it. The sheet is sized with `100dvh`, which does not shrink for the iOS virtual keyboard. **Escalated (S4)** as an unevidenced acceptance row.
- **SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5).** No new id materialisation and no in-app join. Card selection works over rows already loaded into the grid's `selectedRows`, and select-all-matching is unchanged. The phone filter sheet reuses the existing `useLookupValueNames`, which makes one `$in` read and one definition read per lookup target, only to name ids the reader typed into a condition. That is a label lookup for the UI, not a query the server could have joined. **No finding.**

Graded findings (no must-fix):

- **S1 (should-fix).** Changeset and PR body: drop or reword "`FilterPanel` takes `advancedOffered`" under `@object-ui/plugin-list`. `FilterPanel` is not a package export, and the changeset becomes the CHANGELOG text an upgrading agent greps.
- **S2 (should-fix).** `ObjectView` offers 「⋮ More」 → 「Select」 whenever `titleSwitcher` is set, without asking whether the list on screen can select. `ObjectGrid` honours the request only when `rowsSelectable && !singleSelection`. On a list with no or single selection, or on a non-grid view (kanban, calendar), where no grid listens, the item does nothing. Gate it on the list's selectability (the grid already publishes `selectionAvailable` to the action context).
- **S3 (should-fix, escalated).** Either record on #35883 (and #35884), with #35955's acknowledgement, that the Save, discard, save-as, toast and temporary-view-settings acceptance rows move to #35955, or change `Fixes #35883` to a non-closing reference until they are met.
- **S4 (should-fix, escalated).** Evidence the keyboard acceptance row of #35884 (a browser check at 375 with an input focused in the filter value step and in the views search), or name it as a follow-up.
- **N1 (nit).** ✓ on an unchanged sheet, and ✓ on the advanced-filter notice that "edits nothing", still calls `applySort` / `applyPanelFilters`. Sort also resets to page 1. Skip the write when the staged copy equals the value in force.
- **N2 (nit).** The Filter pill counts the top-level entries of `appliedPanelFilters.conditions`, so for an advanced filter a nested group counts as one.
- **N3 (nit).** A card is `role="button"` with `tabIndex={0}` even when it neither opens a record (`rowOpensRecord: false`) nor can select, which leaves a focusable inert control. It also holds interactive children (⋮, link cells) inside a button role.
- **N4 (nit).** The PR body's "Card selection" paragraph names `listPageBarSlot.ts`, but the diff (after the merge) puts these in `listPageScope.ts`.
- **N5 (nit).** The claims on #35883 and #35884 still read `Clause-②: no (provisional)`. Amend them to the measured `yes (widening)`, as the claim itself promised.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `7bea6cb0ea90a090b8d279f763ac06f7066753f7`
Local-runs: none

This is a delta review. It reads only the one commit after `ad6e39cc0e753296a8570463b02f14ada299434a`, the head the previous PASS read: `7bea6cb0e`, "phone 「Select」 only where it opens a selection; sheets stand on the keyboard". The commit touches 9 files. Other inputs: the PR body on this head, and the seat comments it cites, 7061423282 on #35883 and 7061428301 on #35884.

**Gate state** at 2026-11-21T11:19Z: the check-runs on this head are not finished. 9 have succeeded, 15 are skipped, and 18 are still in progress, including Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build and E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, the Plan Test UI shards and the Lint and Type Check families. One run of PR-body guards was cancelled; a later run of PR-body guards on the same head succeeded. Governed Surface Queue Guard and Check PR Size succeeded. This record judges the contract only. It does not answer the gates that are still running; their conclusions are the gate verdicts when they land.

### ① Derived judgments

- **S1 (resolved).** `FilterPanel takes advancedOffered` is gone from the changeset's export list and from the PR body's `Clause-②:` list. The body now calls the prop internal and says why: `FilterPanel` is not a package export. Nothing public changed to make this fix; only the declaration was corrected. **Right.**
- **S2 (resolved).** The fix has three parts:
  - `ObjectGrid` publishes `cardsSelectRequestable = useCardView && rowsSelectable && !singleSelection` through `usePublishListSelectable`. The same flag now also gates the grid's own handling of the request, so the offer and the effect cannot drift apart. `useCardView` is state declared at line 867, ahead of its use, so there is no ordering hazard. The card scroller carries the grid root ref, so the read sees the cards.
  - `ObjectView` gates 「Select」 on `useListPageSelectable(pageColumnEl)`, replacing the old gate on `titleSwitcher`.
  - The tests cover it. `cardSelection-35883` checks `multiple`, `single` and `none`. `ObjectView.phoneFabSelecting-35883` checks absent and present, with a CONTROL. The body says the pin was ablated against the old `rowsSelectable` gate.

  The body also gives the reason it did not reuse the published `selectionAvailable`: that flag is true for single-select lists too. That reason is sound. **Right.**
- **New export `useListPageSelectable`** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid` index). It is a read-only hook over the list-page scope store, shaped like `useListPageSelecting`, and it returns `false` with no scope, no grid mounted, or a non-card or non-multiple list. Its writer, `usePublishListSelectable`, stays internal. The export is additive and its one consumer is app-shell. **Right.**
- **S4 (resolved in code).** `PhonePanelSheet` reads `window.visualViewport` while open (`useKeyboardInset`). When the keyboard is up, the sheet's bottom becomes the keyboard's top and its height becomes the visible height less the 40 px strip. Gaps under 80 px count as browser chrome, not a keyboard. vaul's `repositionInputs` is turned off so the two height writes do not fight; the prop exists in the components package's `vaul` 1.1.2. A unit test with a stand-in `visualViewport` pins the inset going on and off, and the body says it was ablated. **Right as code.** The browser evidence is SIMULATED by the dev's own label (a stand-in viewport in Chromium), not a device reading (see ③).
- **N1 (resolved).** Sort ✓ and filter ✓ now write only when `staged !== value`. `useStaged` takes the copy by reference, so an untouched copy, including the advanced-filter notice, writes nothing. Two tests pin it. An edit that is then reverted still writes an equal value, which is harmless. **Right.**
- **N4 (resolved).** The "Card selection" paragraph now names `listPageScope.ts`. The "Overlap" section's mention of `listPageBarSlot.ts` is about the merge history and is accurate.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset keeps `patch` on the same five packages. This delta moves only `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, which are already listed. The new behaviour (Select gating, keyboard inset, the untouched ✓) is described in the changeset body, which ships as the CHANGELOG.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` still holds: the delta adds no spec key, value or metadata type. Under AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist step 3), `none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. **Matches.**
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` still holds. The delta adds one export (`useListPageSelectable`) and removes or renames nothing published. Dropping `FilterPanel.advancedOffered` from the declaration narrows nothing, because that prop was never reachable. **Widening is correct.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- **S3 (resolved as recorded).** Seat comments 7061423282 (#35883) and 7061428301 (#35884) each do two things:
  - They amend the claim to `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, which closes N5.
  - They hand over the phone Save rows (save to this view, save as my view with a name, discard, the saved toast, and "view settings are temporary") to #35955. #36026 is named as #35955 PR 1, drawing 「Save ▾」 in the phone pill row through `conditionRowEnd`; saving into a shared view follows in #35955 PR 2.

  The PR body's new "Scope with #35955" section cites both comments, so `Fixes #35883` / `Fixes #35884` now close the cards on their other rows with the hand-over on the record. One caveat: "#35955 acknowledges this scope" is the seat's own statement. #35955 is the same seat's card, and the acknowledgement was not read on #35955 itself, which is outside this review's inputs. Also, the #35884 comment lists #35883's Save rows; #35884's own row is the refresh row ("刷新后…「保存」消失"). That is a wording nit and changes no scope.
- **S4 residual (escalated as a note, not blocking).** #35884's keyboard acceptance row has only simulated evidence and a jsdom pin. Before the card's acceptance counts as met on a phone, a real-device reading is owed: iOS Safari at 375, with the filter value step focused and the views search focused.
- **N2 and N3 declined.** The filter count counts top-level entries, and an inert card stays focusable as `role="button"`. Both are declined in the body's "Follow-ups" section. They are nits, and declining them is within the dev's discretion.
- **Follow-up.** The card for the link-cell click while selecting is now promised by the seat.
- **SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5).** The delta adds no data read, no id materialisation and no in-app join. The new store is client-side DOM scoping. **No finding.**

Graded findings on this delta: none must-fix. None should-fix inside the diff. One residual note: the S4 real-device reading is owed at acceptance.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: 7bea6cb0ea · read 2026-11-21T13:00Z · 37 files +2707/−401 · base c00be39b (after #36021) · checks at this head: 46 success · 15 expected skip · PR-body guards: one run cancelled 11:18:11Z, superseded by a success at 11:18:31Z · merges textually clean onto main 8145424b · L2 PASS 7061412796, delta PASS 7061836233

This is the first L1-b record on this PR, a full read at this head rather than a delta. No earlier L1-b record exists here.

**维护者速读：** 手机上打开对象列表，变化是“换容器、不换内容”。顶部一行变成这个列表自己的：返回、对象图标和名称、右边「⋮ 更多」（里面有「选择」、对象说明、导入、收藏）。应用名、搜索、铃铛、头像在列表页不显示，手机上它们在底栏和应用首页里。下面只有一行胶囊按钮：视图、排序、筛选（带当前生效的数量）、搜索。排序、筛选、视图切换、视图设置都改成从底部升起的面板，排序和筛选在副本上改，点「✓」才生效，点「×」作废。长按卡片开始多选，多选时不显示「+」新建按钮。一处小问题建议修：长按开始多选后，如果手指离开时浏览器没有补发一次点击（安卓上常见），接下来点下一张卡片会被吞掉一次，需要点两下才勾上。改动很小，不阻塞合并。

### Must-fix
None.

### Should-fix

**S1 — after a long press, the next tap on a card can be swallowed.** `ObjectGrid.tsx`, the card's `onPointerDown`, `onClick` and `longPress` ref. When the 500 ms timer fires it sets `press.fired = true`, and only the card's `onClick` resets it. That `onClick` swallows the click that follows the press. But `onPointerDown` returns early once `cardSelecting` is on, before its `press.fired = false`. So if the press itself is followed by no click, `fired` stays `true`, and the next tap on any card is eaten. That happens when the finger slides off before lifting, and on Android Chrome, which dispatches no click after a long press whose `contextmenu` fired. The user then has to tap the second card twice to tick it. I read this from the code and did not run it on a device, and the Chromium emulation in the evidence does follow the press with a click. Fix: reset `press.fired = false` at the top of `onPointerDown`, before the early return. A fresh press can then never inherit the old flag, and the click of the same press still sees `true`, because the timer fires after that press's `pointerdown`. One test would pin it: a long press with no click, then a tap on another card, ticks that card.

### Nits

- N1 — the phone top row's icon is the line icon (`createElement(getIcon(objectDef.icon))` in `ObjectView.tsx`). #36042 (#35985 PR 2, ACCEPTed 7062289575, not yet merged) replaces the object's line icon with its colour tile everywhere else, the list's own page bar and view-bar name included. Whichever of the two lands second should draw `ObjectIconTile` here too, so the phone's list heading matches its desktop one.
- N2 — the changeset says "Enter opens it, and while selecting Space toggles it". The card's `onKeyDown` toggles on Enter too while selecting. That is reasonable, since Enter opening a record mid-selection would be odd. Reword the sentence to "while selecting, Enter or Space toggles it".
- N3 — `selectRequests` in `listPageScope.ts` is a module-level `Map<HTMLElement, number>` and never deletes a key, so every page column that ever asked for 「Select」 stays referenced after it unmounts. It is small, one entry per list page visit that used 「Select」, but `selectingRoots` and `selectableRoots` clean up on unmount and this one does not.

### Checked
- `PhonePageBar`: an external store, so publishing a new element on every render re-renders only the two views, not the app bar. Unmount withdraws it. The app bar hides the pill, search, inbox and account groups only when `isApp && phone && !phoneTab && hasPhonePageBar`, and the app bar's own 「‹」 stays.
- Selection wiring: a 「Select」 request counts only when it is made after the grid mounted (`seenSelectionRequest` starts at the mount-time count), so an old request never reopens a selection on a remounted list. 「Select」 is offered only where `useCardView && rowsSelectable && !singleSelection` (L2 S2). The FAB is gated on `useListPageSelecting` (pinned by `ObjectView.phoneFabSelecting-35883`). `BulkActionBar open` draws 「0 selected ×」 with no actions, and Escape ends it at 0 too. Clearing the selection drops `cardSelecting`, and unticking the last card ends it. The card is `role=button` with `tabIndex=0`, takes Enter or Space only for its own target, and has `aria-pressed` while selecting (census entry removed with a repair, not a re-declaration).
- Toolbar below `sm`: `useBelowSm` is a `useSyncExternalStore` on `matchMedia`, so the first client render is already the phone row (no desktop-row frame). The condition row and the desktop row are not drawn there. Quick filters and the queue toggle keep a line of their own. Search is the same element on both widths (`phoneSearch`, moved, not copied). The host's `conditionRowEnd` (Save, #35955) is the row's end.
- Sheets: `useStaged` resets the copy and the first step during render when a sheet opens, so the first frame shows the list's value. 「✓」 writes through the list's own `applySort` / `applyPanelFilters`, and only when the copy changed (`staged !== value`). Empty sort levels are dropped. An 「or」 filter shows the notice and writes nothing. The keyboard inset reads `visualViewport` (ignoring gaps under 80px, which are browser chrome) with vaul's `repositionInputs` off (L2 S4). The sort handle reorders by pointer events for touch, has `data-vaul-no-drag`, and keeps the HTML5 drag and the arrow keys.
- View panel: the phone face puts the search box last with no autofocus, so no keyboard comes up over the views, and 「View settings」 is its last footer row. `ViewSettingsContent` gets the same props as the desktop popover (`viewSettingsElement.props`).
- Shape: draft, `Fixes #35883` and `Fixes #35884` (both cards in one PR, as dispatched; l1-face flags the second keyword by design). One changeset for components, plugin-list, plugin-grid, app-shell and i18n (all patch). `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, which the body lists and the declaration L2 has read. `Metadata-protocol: none`. New keys in every locale; the parity and count-family gates are green.

### Owed
- S1 is the author's or the seat's call. A fix touches only the card handler and one test, so a delta read here is enough. The L1 is final at this head otherwise. The seat lands it. Still owed at acceptance (per the thread): the real iOS Safari 375 keyboard reading asked of Sales.
